text:
rachel: Heads-up: load run showed trace fanout to model workers creates huge observability churn. thinking about an adaptive fanout-mitigation: emit a single tokenized envelope at ingress and let downstream decide to attach spans only when sampler votes to keep. want quick take on tradeoffs.

huey: high level please. how do we avoid losing per-model cost attribution when one request fans out to many model shards?

rachel: proposal: ingress emits CompactTokenEnvelope(request_id, tenant, route, token_hint, model_mask=nil). model_mask optional short list when caller already knows sub-model work. downstream workers still log locally but only one canonical trace is sent to long-term store on sample=true. token_hint used for provisional cost bucketing.

nina: worry: finance wants cost per-model. token_hint alone may not be enough. could we include a tiny delta-report message from each model worker with model_id + token that increments provisional counters (lightweight, aggregated)?

carl: that sounds reasonable if aggregated at the edge; we must keep cardinality low. model_id could blow up. use model-family or model-shard-bucket instead of raw model id.

huey: and what's the sampling trigger? who decides to capture full spans?

rachel: sampler decision remains centralized in canonical pipeline. however model workers can emit a quick local importance score; sampler may use that score to bias keeps. default: keep rate 1% but bias up if importance>threshold.

nina: how to handle retries and dupes? token must be stable across retries to avoid double provisional counts. make token deterministic from request id + tenant + short window ts.

carl: also need idempotency key on the aggregated delta-report so aggregator can dedupe. token+model-bucket should be unique enough for short TTL aggregation.

ops-bot: Note: current ingest schema does not include model_mask or token_hint. Change requires versioned envelope.

huey: rollout concerns? this touches ingest, model-side clients, billing, and console. we need a staged plan.

rachel: rollout plan sketch: 1) define v2 CompactTokenEnvelope proto + translator shim for backcompat; 2) model workers emit delta-report to a lightweight aggregator (FF); 3) billing service accepts provisional increments keyed by token+model-bucket and resolves when canonical trace materializes; 4) console exposes provisional vs settled per-model-family; 5) canary small tenants then wider.

nina: testing: verify no double-counting under retry storms, and that provisional->settled join is correct under reordering. add chaos test that delays canonical pipeline arbitrarily.

carl: observability: dashboards for aggregated delta rate, unresolved-token backlog, token-resolve-latency histogram, delta-report collision rate. add alert if unresolved-token backlog > threshold.

huey: fallback: if join-table resolution lags or delta mismatch > 1% we switch ingress to full fanout for affected tenants for a window. implement a circuit that tracks divergence and flips.

rachel: perf note: aggregator must be scalable; use dimension-limited aggregation (token+model-bucket) and shard by tenant. keep retention of provisional increments short (1h) to bound storage.

nina: security/compliance: provisional tokens are opaque; do not persist PII. ensure token generation uses cryptographic hash with salt per-region.

carl: one more: add a debug capture header to force-per-request full capture for support sessions. ensure rate-limited.

ops-bot: Feature-flag "tokenized-ingest" created for canaries.

rachel: follow-ups: rachel+huey: proto + translator + sample code (ETA 3d). nina+carl: delta-aggregator design + billing join + dashboard mappings (ETA 5d). ops: add FF rollout automation + circuit config (ETA 4d). obs-bot: create ticket OBS-4110.

obs-bot: Created task: OBS-4110 "tokenized ingest + per-model delta-aggregation" assigned to rachel,huey,nina,carl.

huey: great. add a short RFC appendix with sequence diagram and example messages. I'll review.

rachel: will draft and post link. tagging @nina @carl for visibility. :rocket:
